title: SolarFCD: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Solar Fault Classification in Photovoltaic Systems
mechanism: Builds a benchmark by merging public RGB and thermal sets with a unified label map, near-duplicate removal and fixed splits, then runs 16 classifiers.
evidence: R: 4,435 images, 4 merged classes, 80:10:10; best ResNet101V2 acc 86.68 %, F1 88.17.
adaptation: Benchmark hygiene for EL: unified class map and cross-release de-duplication (BenchmarkEL 2021 / 2022 / E-SCDD / UCF-EL); avoid its random split, which mixes plants.
min_experiment: CPU: perceptual-hash near-duplicate scan across EL releases, train vs test; report duplicate counts. No kill line (hygiene).
